title: Splotch of Paint
description: Splotch of Paint is a datapack/resourcepack combo adding in 155 new custom paintings to minecraft of fully original design.
body:
# **Splotch of Paint**

## **A resourcepack and datapack combo package that adds over 100 new paintings to your game. All custom made and in vanilla friendly resolutions.**

![Image showcasing a small slider of paintings from the pack, accompanied by the phrase "More paintings than you know what to do with"](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7a3da85bcd326113496d6a8a5dbc60613c11fc86.png)

**Decorate with a wide variety of themes, from sci-fi, portraits, mystery, nature, and more! There literally is a style for anyone**

**The pack works well on servers, needing only the server running it to install the datapack, while the players only require the resourcepack. And both are quite lightweight.**

**It works from versions 1.21.9 upwards, and the paintings are all properly named with a special colour for the title and author name.**

### **How does it work?**

**Simply download both the resourcepack and accompanying datapack if you're planning on running it in your own world, activate both in their respective folders and you're good to go.**

**You don't really need the datapack though if the world you play in, be it a realm, server, etc... is already running it. In these cases as long as you have the resourcepack active it will work.**

**Alternatively a packaged mod version of both will eventually be available for download if zip files aren't to your liking.**

### **Final Note**

**This pack has been a big hobby of mine, and even though I work alone, I wouldn't have gotten here without the support from the community. Thank you for all the suggestions, the feedback, and everything else.**

**And as always, I hope you enjoy the pack.**
